# stalwart_dkim_signature_dkim1_rsa_sha256 (Resource)

Defines a DKIM signature used to sign outgoing email messages. Manages the DKIM1 (RSA SHA-256) variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `private_key` (Attributes) PEM-encoded private key used to sign outgoing messages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_key))

### Optional

- `auid` (String) Agent or user identifier included in the DKIM signature header
- `canonicalization` (String) Canonicalization algorithm applied to the headers and body before signing
- `domain_id` (String) Identifier for the domain this DKIM signature is associated with
- `expire` (Number) Time after which this DKIM signature expires and should no longer be considered valid
- `headers` (Set of String) List of message headers to include in the DKIM signature
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this DKIM signature belongs to Requires an Enterprise license.
- `next_transition_at` (String) Date when this key will transition to the next rotation stage, or null if no transition is scheduled
- `report` (Boolean) Whether to request failure reports when signature verification fails on the recipient side
- `selector` (String) Selector used to locate the DKIM public key in DNS
- `stage` (String) Current stage of the DKIM key in its rotation lifecycle
- `third_party` (String) Authorized third-party signature value, used when signing on behalf of another domain
- `third_party_hash` (String) Hashing algorithm used to verify the authorized third-party signature DNS record

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the DKIM signature
- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
- `public_key` (String) PEM-encoded public key used to verify signatures, derived from the private key

<a id="nestedatt--private_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_key`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from
